title: Bottom dock: a 52-unit bar of six items with a raised five-sided CTA plate in the middle, the current item underlined in green over a dot field
use: The fixed bottom navigation of a full-screen-per-topic game site or a game lobby. Six destinations, one two-line call to action.

glow.note: the green dot field over the current item

relations: Bar 52 units high; items 147 wide from x 391 (three left, three right of the plate).
The plate is 165 x 110, centred, its shoulders at 34% of its height; the CTA is two lines of two characters in green on the deep green plate.
decoration: The dot field, the underline, the plate outline and the chevron: drawn.

provenance.corpus: stillfield case (寂原行动 STILLFIELD): our own original one-page game site and three in-game screens in the milspec-ops grammar
provenance.experiment: styles/milspec-ops/style.json provenance (live reference site measured privately; never shipped)
provenance.method: Measured on the reference: dock 52 high, items 147 x 93, CTA 165 x 110 at x 878; the case keeps them.
